methods.rule: Compare head/body proportion and front/rear silhouettes; side views constrain depth. Uncalibrated reference lighting and occlusion do not establish geometry errors.
A static body surface must be continuous at neck, shoulders and hips. Voxel fusion is a sculpting base, not animation-ready topology.
Keep eyes and hair separately editable. Check fringe, side locks, rear hair length and facial silhouette against the respective reference.
Do not apply rigid-owner batching to a deformable body. Rigging, skin weights, expression shapes and motion tests require a separate stage and evidence.
A review produces only an asset-scoped candidate lesson with source hashes; model opinion is not user acceptance or cross-asset validation.
